shared_elements: low relief carving on a flat panel/upright slab
vertically repeated small motifs arranged in a column (stylised plant elements in A, sign blocks in B)
justification: The only real correspondence is that both surfaces carry shallow relief on an upright rectangular field with a vertical succession of small repeated motifs along one axis, which is a very generic trait. A depicts a large winged anthropomorphic figure in profile holding objects beside a stylised plant, while B shows only dense grids of compact abstract sign-blocks with no figures, relationships or scene at all.
